project_name: Sanidhya & Vasudha - Royal Indian Wedding Invitation

art_direction.theme: Cinematic Royal Indian Wedding Invitation with Subtle Silicon/VLSI Circuit Elegance
art_direction.vibe: Royal Rajasthani Palace meets Timeless Romance & Subtle Micro-Electronics Heritage

subtle_circuit_motif_rules.concept: Both Sanidhya & Vasudha work in VLSI & Integrated Circuit Design. Their love story features a bespoke 'Heart-shaped IC Chip & Gold Trace' motif.
execution_guidelines: Must remain delicate, subtle, and metallic gold. NEVER use futuristic neon blue, cyber green, or harsh tech-company aesthetics.
Integrate fine 0.5px gold PCB trace lines as ornamental filigree borders on invitation cards and envelope edges.
The 'Heart-Circuit Monogram' combines an interlocking 'S&V' inside an ornamental gold die layout with tiny gold bonding pads at the corners.
Circuit signal traces end in small floral lotus nodes or star dots, seamlessly fusing ancient Mughal jali geometric art with semiconductor layouts.

envelope_opening_choreography.step_1_closed_envelope: Closed Burgundy Velvet Envelope lying on a dark wooden teak surface with warm candle bokeh, floating rose petals, and subtle lantern glow.
envelope_opening_choreography.step_2_wax_seal: Center embossed wax seal (#800A1D) with metallic gold 'S & V' heart-circuit monogram and 'Tap to Open' golden pulsing text ring.
envelope_opening_choreography.step_3_interaction: On user click/tap on wax seal: Wax seal glows warmly, develops gold-crack line animation, seal splits in two with particle sparkle burst.
envelope_opening_choreography.step_4_flap_open: Top envelope triangular flap rotates upward and flips open with realistic 3D perspective shadow.
envelope_opening_choreography.step_5_card_slide: Ivory wedding invitation card with gold-foil circuit filigree slides up out of the envelope and zooms full-screen smoothly.
envelope_opening_choreography.step_6_site_reveal: Envelope fades away to reveal full single-page interactive wedding experience with gentle floating petals and ambient audio button option.

1_hero_envelope.description: Interactive wax-seal envelope reveal on dark teakwood texture with interactive particle canvas for gentle floating red rose petals and gold bokeh particles.

2_main_invitation.description: Formal invitation text card on rich Ivory paper texture with gold foil floral/circuit border, ornamental divider, auspicious shloka ('Vakratunda Mahakaya'), and formal invitation text from families.

3_events_timeline.description: Interactive chronological timeline with 4 core celebrations: Mehndi Ceremony, Sangeet Night, Wedding Royal Muhurat (Pheras), and Grand Reception. Each event card features palace arch frames, precise gold time indicators, venue name, address, and interactive 'Add to Calendar' button.

4_venue_palace.description: Cinematic visual showcase featuring high-res palace imagery, interactive parallax movement, Google Maps location modal, dress code recommendations, and accommodation details.

5_editorial_marquee_footer.description: Slow luxury marquee with sliding text ('#SanidhyaWedsVasudha • #SiliconToSoulmate • A Celebration of Love & Destiny'), RSVP contact popup, and bottom heart-circuit monogram.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, modals, envelope triggers, timeline items, and links MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='wax-seal-open-btn', data-testid='event-card-sangeet').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_header: Headers and overlays must use solid/semi-solid rich colors or high-blur glassmorphism with dark tint (#25040A background with 0.95 opacity).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) to ensure the card layout breathes like a physical luxury heavy-cardstock print.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_rules: All gold text over dark wine background must maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast using antique gold (#E1BF78) or bright ivory (#F7EBD5).
